source: OECD ICIO 2025, 2022 table (the file S03 reads, 2022_SML.csv): NGA C10T12 output 107,093 m USD, of which 36,456 m (34.0%) is the domestic diagonal, passed unchanged to io_s12; the cap is the fbt world 90th percentile of the domestic diagonal share in the beta v4 S12 prior (13.8%, (internal QA file) issue 2a; median 8.1%, CIV 10.8%, ZAF 12.8%)
decided_by: David (beta v5 package N1, approved 2026-10-27 08:39 UTC)
basis: Beta v5 N1: NGA fbt own use is 34-36% of output, the highest of 167 regions, and S13 scales it with the GDP (output 169 bn, 26% of GDP). The cap is applied to the diagonal (domestic plus imported, basic value over the column) as for the energy diagonals; the domestic excess is netted out of row and column, so output falls (about -40 bn) and VA, GDP and final demand stay. Our rule, not in the GTAP text (GTAP 12 ch.17A has no own-use target); a listed cell, not a blanket cap (a 15% cap on every non-energy diagonal would remove about 5.9 tn of world output, and CHN tal and JPN stl diagonals are real).
